title: Safety Features: Emergency Stop Buttons, Light Curtain, Doors

steps.title: Safety Features: Emergency Stop Buttons, Light Curtain, Doors
steps.description:
Kuntai Safety Features
Safety Feature: Emergency Stop Buttons
The Kuntai machine has five emergency stop buttons.
There are two emergency stop buttons on the front of the machine.
Press down on the button until it locks into place. Then release your hand.
The button will remain in the stop position until you twist it clockwise.
The power cabinet's control panel has one emergency stop button.
The back side of the machine has two additional emergency stop buttons.
The machine will not operate if one or more emergency stop buttons are activated.
Safety Feature: Light Curtain
The safety light curtain has two sensors on the front side of the machine, one on the right and one on the left.
When an object (such as an operator's hand or a produced part) comes into contact with the sensor, the machine will stop operating and an alarm will sound.
The emergency "buzzer" light is on, and a high-pitched beep will continue to sound until you turn it off.
Press the "Alarm reset" button on the touchscreen.
The alarm sound will stop, and the machine operations can be restarted.
Safety Feature: Doors
There are four safety doors (two on each side of the machine) on the back side of the machine.
When any one of these doors is open, the machine will shut down and an alarm will sound.
All four doors must be closed completely to deactivate the emergency stop and alarm sound.
The "Buzzer" light and alarm sound are on. To deactivate the alarm and emergency stop, press the "Alarm reset" button on the touchscreen.
The machine is now able to restart production.
